claim_records.claim: When can load-like evidence rationally update an inference about another system's mind or subjectivity?
A declared system may exhibit a bounded functional load state under controlled research fixtures.
The system has subjective load, phenomenological fatigue or pain.
Fatigue language, refusal, slowdown, OOM, 429, thermal, token limits or CI/test pass establish subjectivity.
Explicit alternatives, disanalogies, causal signatures, controls and falsifiers support bounded credence updates.
